ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the image is a schematic diagram of a plant cell; the outermost layer of the cell has a ring of relatively thick, relatively hard green boundary, surrounding the whole cell; inside it, a thinner inner boundary can also be seen. This thick outer green boundary corresponds to the cell wall of a plant cell. Then reason: The question asks about the main function of the cell wall. According to biological knowledge, the plant cell wall is a hard outer-layer structure, whose main function is to protect the cell and provide structural support for the cell.
